MATCHING RECORDS: 2

  • Scale of Universe:
    An interactive HTML5 web experience originally created by Cary and Michael Huang that allows users to seamlessly zoom from subatomic quantum scales up to the observable universe.
  • WorldWide Telescope:
    An open-source, web-based planetarium software suite curated by the American Astronomical Society that merges terabytes of observational data and real telescope images into a seamless 3D sky map.
